description: This file defines an interface ITransactionManager for managing transactional operations in a distributed system, including methods for preparing, committing, and pinging transactions, as well as a struct AccessCounter for tracking read/write accesses.

classes.name: AccessCounter
classes.description: A struct counting read and write accesses within a transaction.

methods.name: PrepareAndCommit
methods.description: Prepares and commits a transaction, returning the transaction status.

methods.name: Prepared
methods.description: Notifies the transaction manager of a participant's prepare result.

methods.name: Ping
methods.description: Participants send a keep-alive message to the transaction manager.
